description: This file defines the MainActivity class in an Android application that displays a PDF using a fragment. It sets up the activity's layout, manages the options menu, and shows an alert dialog with info when a menu item is selected.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that hosts a PDF rendering fragment and provides menu options for user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the PDF renderer fragment.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles actions when menu items are selected, displaying an info dialog.
